name: Eyes of the Owl
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 225, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 52
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 225, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 52
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th
Slot eyes; Price 4,000 gp; Weight —
Description
These magical goggles are decorated with owl motifs, including clusters of feathers over the eyes. The wearer gains low-light vision.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape I; Cost 2,000 gp
